response_normalization: GET /product prose example has a missing closing quote after a Date value; repaired JSON syntax without changing values.
POST and PUT /customer prose examples have a missing comma after CreditLimit and a trailing comma; repaired JSON syntax without changing values.

spec_defects.description: The shared Customer and Supplier schemas require ID on POST, but the provider POST request examples omit ID and return a newly allocated ID. The node follows those creation examples.

NewStockLineModel requires non-null BatchSN unconditionally, while its prose requires it only for non-FIFO products and the POST/PUT examples use null. The node allows it to be omitted. The date-time schema also rejects the provider timezone-free UTC dates used by both examples and the introduction Date Format section.

GET /product and PUT /customer response schemas reference single Product/Customer records, but their Response 200 Example prose returns paginated Products/CustomerList envelopes. The harness rejects the documented witnesses against those schemas and falls back to generated single-record responses; the node follows and passes the documented envelopes.
